incident_text: The river has overflowed and flooded the fields and part of the city.

result.scene_summary: A composite satellite image showing two different views of a river system with surrounding urban and agricultural areas, including labeled regions such as West Memphis, Memphis, Mud Island, and Treasure Island.

observations.description: Clouds or smoke plumes over the landscape, especially in the lower image
Urban areas with roads and buildings, including labeled places like West Memphis, Memphis, Mud Island, and Treasure Island
Green patches of vegetation and fields in the agricultural areas
River channels and islands with visible topography and some structures on islands
